item.title: Meet Colette Kress, Nvidia’s New Interim CEO
item.description: Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer helped transform the company into an AI powerhouse. Now she’s taking the reins following Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday.

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Nvidia’s cofounder and chief executive resigned on Thursday after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

item.title: Alex Karp Said He’s a ‘Progressive.’ OK! Here’s Some Other Stuff He’s Said Recently
item.description: The Palantir CEO touted his “progressive” worldview in a recent interview. Let’s see how that lines up with his comments during the company’s earnings call two weeks ago.

item.title: Google Wanted Spirit Airlines Data. Flight Attendants Found a Way to Opt Out
item.description: The union representing flight attendants for the defunct airline struck a deal with Google to scrub sensitive employee records from a $10 million data sale.

item.title: I Saw the Future of Robotics in a Virtual Duck That Chases My Cat
item.description: An OpenAI model helped me teach the Microduck to waddle and moonlight as a tiny cat butler.

item.title: A Startup Wants to Fight AI Bioweapons With AI
item.description: Radical Numerics has developed a model that it says can identify natural and AI-engineered pathogens without an internet connection.

item.title: The AO3 Shutdown Is Pitting Fanfic Readers Against Authors
item.description: “It has left a sour taste in my mouth,” says a Heated Rivalry fanfic author who found her work uploaded to AO3 mirror sites without her consent.

item.title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
item.description: China’s use of sexpionage is a well-established intelligence tactic with recent, high-profile examples. So how did the world’s most powerful AI executive fall for it?

item.title: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
item.description: The young girl’s parents allege that she used Gemini via her school Chromebook to plan her suicide, but the school’s monitoring systems didn’t know until it was almost too late.

item.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
item.description: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
